import itertools
import json

categories = {
    "opinion": "nice wonderful good lovely obnoxious mysterious silly awful terrible ridiculous repulsive",
    "purpose": "whittling drinking hiking snorkeling typing exercise eating smoking driving walking",
    "size": "massive enormous big huge midsize small tiny medium-size normal-size large little",
    "color": "gray brown yellow indigo violet blue maroon green black red aqua teal cyan crimson pink",
    "age": "ancient new old-fashioned brand-new archaic old",
    "shape": "spherical pyramidal square circular prismlike rectangular triangular",
    "material": "cardboard glass steel fiberglass iron cloth wool plastic rubber wood paper",
    "origin": "indian vietnamese turkish russian egyptian thai bangladeshi congolese iranian american ethiopian indonesian pakistani mexican filipino japanese",
}
category_of = {
    word: category
    for category, words in categories.items()
    for word in words.split()
}

givens = """ancient bicycle
nice apple

spherical jar

wonderful scissors
brown scissors""".splitlines()

options = {
    "A": "nice typing big yellow new rectangular wool box",
    "B": "silly whittling little gray archaic square vietnamese bird",
    "C": "mexican medium-size violet ancient spherical typing silly bicycle",
    "D": "plastic large blue old-fashioned rectangular whittling good flower pot",
    "E": "wood turkish tiny pink archaic prismlike whittling ruler",
    "F": "silly hiking medium-size black old-fashioned spherical mexican steel necklace",
    "G": "terrible eating midsize green brand-new prismlike ruler",
    "H": "filipino paper small violet new spherical snorkeling lamp",
    "I": "snorkeling little brown old circular plastic american sunglasses",
    "J": "japanese glass midsize aqua brand-new spherical flower pot",
}

def adjective_categories(sentence):
    return [category_of[word] for word in sentence.split()
            if word in category_of]

def precedence_pairs(sequence):
    return {
        (sequence[i], sequence[j])
        for i in range(len(sequence))
        for j in range(i + 1, len(sequence))
    }

assert len(givens) == 150
constraints = set()
for sentence in givens:
    constraints.update(precedence_pairs(adjective_categories(sentence)))

orders = []
for order in itertools.permutations(categories):
    position = {category: i for i, category in enumerate(order)}
    if all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in constraints):
        orders.append(position)

if not orders:
    print(json.dumps({"final_answer": "UNSUPPORTED",
                      "evidence": "Inconsistent category-order constraints."}))
else:
    counts = {}
    for letter, sentence in options.items():
        pairs = precedence_pairs(adjective_categories(sentence))
        counts[letter] = sum(
            all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in pairs)
            for position in orders
        )

    accepted = "".join(letter for letter in options if counts[letter] > 0)
    print(json.dumps({
        "final_answer": accepted or "K",
        "evidence": {
            "method": "Exhaustive category orders; reject options contradicting the givens.",
            "consistent_orders": len(orders),
            "compatible_orders_by_option": counts
        }
    }, separators=(",", ":")))
